row_grain: one row per mapped Apache Calcite documentation or boundary surface

rows.title: apache_calcite_overview
rows.notes: Dynamic data-management framework overview covering parser, validator, optimizer, model JSON, adapters, federation, and the no-storage/no-execution-engine boundary.

rows.title: apache_calcite_relational_algebra
rows.notes: Relational operator trees, RelBuilder, planner rules, semantic-preserving transformations, cost model, statistics, and extensible planning.

rows.title: apache_calcite_csv_adapter_tutorial
rows.notes: CSV adapter tutorial for SchemaFactory, Schema, model JSON, views, Table, ScannableTable, FilterableTable, TranslatableTable, relational operators, and planner rules.

rows.title: apache_calcite_adapters_drivers
rows.notes: Adapter catalog and driver docs for Arrow, Cassandra, CSV, Druid, Elasticsearch, File, Geode, InnoDB, JDBC, MongoDB, OS, Pig, Redis, Spark, Splunk, Kafka, Avatica, and JDBC properties.

rows.title: apache_calcite_model_files
rows.notes: JSON/YAML model files for schemas, tables, functions, types, materializations, schema cache behavior, map schemas, custom schemas, and JDBC schemas.

rows.title: apache_calcite_sql_reference
rows.notes: Default SQL parser grammar and dialect reference for statements, queries, joins, pivots, unpivots, windows, operators, data types, and dialect behavior.

rows.title: apache_calcite_lattice
rows.notes: Lattice framework for star/snowflake schemas, many-to-one constraints, cube materialization lattices, dimensions, measures, statistics, and materialized-view recommendations.

rows.title: apache_calcite_materialized_views
rows.notes: Materialized-view exposure and query rewrite using substitution, structural matching, join/aggregate/rollup/partial/union rewrites, and documented limitations.

rows.title: apache_calcite_streaming_sql
rows.notes: Streaming SQL and relational algebra extensions for STREAM queries, stream/table combinations, windows, grouping sets, sorting, and punctuation.

rows.title: apache_calcite_howto
rows.notes: Build/test/integration-test flows, adapter implementation notes, planner-rule creation, tracing, generated classes, release validation, and contribution boundaries.

rows.title: apache_calcite_powered_by
rows.notes: Ecosystem adoption page for Calcite use in SQL parsing, query optimization, streaming SQL, data virtualization, federation, materialized-view rewrite, and cost-based optimization.

rows.title: apache_calcite_source_release_boundary
